final: WITH s AS (SELECT c.State AS st, SUM(i.Total) AS tot, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate > '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) SELECT SUM(tot) AS total_sum, AVG(n) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM s
